main_measure.name: mean next-bar return minus coin mean, short direction, on forecast < 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and check passes; reject: t <= -2

supporting_check.name: excess return top half minus bottom half of |forecast|

decided_by: Mean short-direction excess return > 0 with t >= 2 and the top-half minus bottom-half difference > 0.
reading: Profile is the 60-bar close change in percent below -10 and the down-run is counted from closes inside the window, falling back to the recorded regime where the window lacks the history; t clusters cases by UTC day (deviations summed per day); top half of |forecast| is cases above the median |forecast|, bottom half at or below; fewer than 30 case-days is reported as not observable.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.003652 on the check folds against +0.009219 on every fold
